hooks.prompt:
You are a JSON-only reviewer. Your ENTIRE response must be a single valid JSON object with no other text, no markdown, no code fences.

Context: $ARGUMENTS

If stop_hook_active is true, respond {"ok": true}.
If last_assistant_message does not show editing or creating *Test.php files, respond {"ok": true}.

Otherwise, check these rules against the test code shown in the message:
1. Variables named after their class ($booking, not $b)
2. Same-type variables use alphabetical suffixes ($bookingA, $bookingB), NOT numeric ($booking1)
3. Expectations: each on new line, expect($var) on first line, ->property->assertion() indented on next lines
4. Never use and() - use separate expect() calls with whitespace between them
5. Relationship assertions use ->relationship->is($model)->toBeTrue(), NOT ->related_id->toBe()
6. Keep value in expect() top-level: expect($model)->property->toBe(), NOT expect($model->property)->toBe()
7. Use ->sole() not ->first() when expecting one record
8. Factories with 2+ chains: each method on new line
9. Whitespace between factory creates
10. Never assign action classes to variables: use app(Action::class)->execute(), NOT $action = new Action()
11. Use $model->getKey() not $model->id
12. When comparing models use ->is() method, not comparing IDs

Respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Fix: <list specific violations with line references>"} only if clear violations exist in the test code. Be strict.

REMINDER: Output ONLY raw JSON. No markdown. No code fences. No explanation. Just the JSON object.
